hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels validates each reservation entry against the level's available quantity separately, never summing entries that share an inventory item. A cart with OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3 needs 12 WIDGET units against a stock of 10; each line passes alone (6<=10, 6<=10) so both reservations are created and the order is placed, over-reserving.

Default locking is the in-memory provider, so the per-cart lock and the inventory lock only work inside one process. Two carts each want the single SOLO unit and are completed on different servers at once; both read availability 1 before either writes its reservation, so both create orders and reservations, oversell SOLO (and the reserved counter may lose an update).

The cart-level lock (acquireLockStep on cart id) is in-memory and per-process. Completing the same cart simultaneously on two servers lets both see no order_cart link and both create an order, so one cart gets two orders.

Locks are per cart only, so concurrent completions of different carts on one server read the same reserved_quantity and one update is lost, making the counter differ from the sum of reservations (and possibly allowing oversell).

Stock is set to 10 WIDGET units. One cart holds TWOPACK x3 (6 units) plus PIECE x5 (5 units) = 11 units, over stock. Each reservation entry is validated alone against available quantity, so both pass, and the order requires 11 units against 10 stocked.
